entries.name: Anime & Manga
entries.description: AniList titles, airing status and adaptations. Commercial permission required; no downloads.

entries.name: Barcodes & QR
entries.description: Scan barcodes locally and create QR or barcode files in your Workspace.

entries.name: AI Benchmarks
entries.description: Compare published model benchmark evidence from OpenRouter and BenchLM, with source dates and uncertainty.

entries.name: Books & Comics
entries.description: Open Library and Google Books bibliographic search and ISBN lookup; keep editions distinct.

entries.name: Browser
entries.description: Use a real web browser: open pages, click, fill in forms and download files.

entries.name: Code Sandbox
entries.description: Files and folders in your workspace, and an network-isolated sandbox to write and run code.

entries.name: Your Computer
entries.description: Let Iris run commands on your own computer through the Dyadic Runner and send you files from it: build and start Docker containers, deploy, use your tools. Pair it with one command and a code; it asks you first unless you allow it.

entries.name: Conversions
entries.description: Dated currency reference rates and local physical-unit conversions.

entries.name: Database
entries.description: Explore and query your PostgreSQL, MySQL and SQLite databases. Reads only, unless you allow changes, and every change asks you first.

entries.name: Documents
entries.description: Read, make and edit Word, PDF, Markdown and text files.

entries.name: Flight Observations
entries.description: FlyItalyADSB aircraft observations near coordinates or by callsign, registration or ICAO hex. Community receiver coverage, not schedules or fares.

entries.name: Food & Nutrition
entries.description: Look up food labels, barcodes, nutrients and recipes.

entries.name: Forensics
entries.description: Investigate public sources, organize private cases and inspect evidence, relationships and timelines.

entries.name: Game Catalog
entries.description: CheapShark deals and Steam metadata, requirements and regional prices. Separate from games to play.

entries.name: GitHub
entries.description: Read and change your GitHub repositories: push code from your Workspace, create repositories and branches, open and merge pull requests, and manage issues. Every change asks you first.

entries.name: Google Workspace
entries.description: Drive, Gmail, Calendar, Docs and Sheets as your Google account, at the level you allow each. Sending email, calendar changes and edits ask you first.

entries.name: Health & Exercise
entries.description: Public RxNorm drug references, FDA drug recalls and attributed wger exercise browsing. Medical research reuses Science.

entries.name: History
entries.description: Wikipedia and Wikidata historical discovery with sourced identifiers and article links.

entries.name: Holidays
entries.description: Nager.Date and OpenHolidays public, school and regional holiday calendars.

entries.name: HTTP Request
entries.description: Call web APIs, REST and GraphQL, with the sign-ins you save. Every change asks you first.

entries.name: Image Analysis
entries.description: Look at an image and describe it, or answer a question about it.

entries.name: Image Generation
entries.description: Create images from a description or a reference upload.

entries.name: Knowledge Search
entries.description: Search your files, chats, projects and memory, and cite them.

entries.name: Memory
entries.description: Learn lasting preferences, remember what you ask, and find, change or forget it later.

entries.name: Movies & Television
entries.description: TVMaze show discovery, cast, episode guides and schedules; films through existing Reference.

entries.name: Music
entries.description: MusicBrainz artist, release and recording metadata. Hosted permission or private evaluation access required.

entries.name: OCR
entries.description: Read the text in scans, screenshots, receipts and photos of documents.

entries.name: Web Page Reader
entries.description: Open and read a link you share.

entries.name: Scheduler
entries.description: Have an agent do something on a schedule, like every Tuesday or every hour, and tell you when something happens.

entries.name: Science & Research
entries.description: Search Crossref and OpenAlex publications and look up DOI metadata.

entries.name: Scripture
entries.description: Commercially reusable Bible translations, books and verse-preserving chapter reads through Free Use Bible API.

entries.name: Space
entries.description: Find NASA media, astronomy pictures and upcoming space launches.

entries.name: Speech
entries.description: Read an answer or any text aloud as an audio file you can play.

entries.name: Sports
entries.description: OpenLigaDB community leagues, match schedules, results and standings. Primarily European football coverage.

entries.name: Spreadsheets
entries.description: Make and edit Excel and CSV files, with formulas, tables and charts.

entries.name: Transcription
entries.description: Write down what an audio file you attach says.

entries.name: Travel
entries.description: Wikivoyage travel guides connected to existing Overture places, Valhalla routes and weather.

entries.name: Vehicles
entries.description: NHTSA VIN decoding, recalls and FuelEconomy.gov vehicle specifications and estimates.

entries.name: Weather
entries.description: Forecasts, official alerts and specialized weather data, with source attribution.

entries.name: Web Search
entries.description: Search the web and cite sources before answering.
